title: Servex: turn on Windows crash dumps for node.exe (admin, ~2 min)
why: Servex has fast-failed (0xC0000409) 6 times since 2026-11-03, most recently 06:09Z on 2026-11-07. A fast-fail skips every JavaScript handler, so only a Windows crash dump can show where it died (Servex/doc/restart.md, 'A native fast-fail'). Memory and handles were ordinary at the last crash (64% commit, 158 handles).

wait.what: run the one admin command (step 1); a full dump is about 400 MB, and at most 3 are kept

add.title:
In an admin PowerShell: New-Item -Force 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\LocalDumps
ode.exe' | Out-Null; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\LocalDumps
ode.exe' DumpFolder "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\lew42\servex\dumps"; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\LocalDumps
ode.exe' DumpType 2 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\LocalDumps
ode.exe' DumpCount 3 -Type DWord
After the next crash, an agent opens the .dmp in %LOCALAPPDATA%\lew42\servex\dumps to find the faulting module
